title: TransactionEvent v1
description: Input transaction event on topic fraud.transactions.v1, replayed by the producer from processed PaySim data. Does NOT contain the ground-truth label (isFraud) or the rule flag (isFlaggedFraud). Owner: Streaming & Serving Lead. Status: W1 DRAFT, pending Lead sign-off.

schema_version.description: Message schema version. Adding an optional field -> 1.x; a breaking change -> new .v2 topic.

transaction_id.description: Unique key generated deterministically in ETL: 'ps_' + row number (1-based, 8 digits) in the original PaySim file. Used as the idempotency key at the sink.

event_time.description: Time the transaction occurred (event time, UTC, ISO-8601). Simulated from step: SIM_START + (step-1) hours + offset within the hour. This is the column used for watermarks/windows.

step.description: Original PaySim step value (1 step = 1 simulated hour). Kept for traceability and to reproduce event_time.

transaction_type.description: Transaction type, mapped from PaySim column 'type'.

amount.description: Transaction amount (PaySim local currency units). Mapped from 'amount'.

source_account.description: Originating account, mapped from 'nameOrig'. Used as the Kafka message key.

destination_account.description: Receiving account, mapped from 'nameDest'. Prefix 'M' = merchant (no balance information).

old_balance_orig.description: Source account balance BEFORE the transaction, mapped from 'oldbalanceOrg'. OPTIONAL: the Kaggle description warns that balance columns carry leakage risk, so whether it is used as a feature is decided by Data & ML Evaluation / Batch & ML Lead (W1-W2).

old_balance_dest.description: Destination account balance BEFORE the transaction, mapped from 'oldbalanceDest'. OPTIONAL, same conditions as old_balance_orig. Always 0 for merchants (no data).

produced_at.description: Time the producer sent the message (wall clock, UTC). Used to measure end-to-end latency = scored_at - produced_at. Not used for windows.

replay_id.description: Replay run identifier (e.g. 'replay_20261020_01'), used to tell replay runs apart in logs/benchmarks. NOT part of the idempotency key.
